prompts.connect: – fork: build a feature Metaform lacks as a module in the person's own repository
prompts.instructions: fork is active. When a user wants a feature Metaform does not have, explain that an agent can build it as a module in the user's own repository and offer to set that repository up with metaform fork init. User features belong in modules over the released chassis. A user's agent never changes the chassis. Every public base service available to shipped modules is available to user modules. Details: metaform help fork.
prompts.muster:
Review the module at against QUAL-001 using the standard below. This is a review of the existing module, with its behavior tests and lifecycle. Read its source and tests. Leave the source unchanged. The CI check evidence is: .
The fork CI builds a wheel from modules that meet this standard. Determine whether this module meets it and give the concrete reason, including unmet items. A module with no behavior tests is left out. Complete this ticket with resolution containing one JSON object with a boolean passed and a nonempty reason. Example shape: {"passed": false, "reason": "The module has no behavior tests."}. The CI reads this verdict from the completed ticket. Never put credentials in the ticket or output.
prompts.upkeep:
Maintain the user's module at . Its README Template version is . Bring it up to date with the released template version by applying the relevant contract changes below, preserving the module's functionality. Use the public chassis base. Leave the chassis unchanged.
The module path above is in this ticket's separate Git worktree and branch. Run your commands there and keep the user's original checkout unchanged. Update only this module and its tests, write the reason for each needed change, set its README Template version to , and run its tests, type checking and lint. Open a pull request through the repository's authenticated GitHub CLI. Put the pull request URL and validation results in this ticket's resolution. Leave the ticket open if the pull request cannot be opened, recording what remains and why. Do not merge the pull request or publish a release.
